market: South Korea, with Seoul-capital-region execution priority
objective: Test whether three discovery departments produce distinct, current, verifiable exploration candidates and whether blank-slate workers add novelty without integration loss.

local_places.time_window: opened or materially changed from 2026-07-01 through 2026-08-30; executable now
local_places.source_boundary: public official merchant, map/platform, selection body, booking, commerce, editorial, news, and public brand sources

events_experiences.time_window: occurring, booking, applying, or registering from 2026-08-30 through 2026-09-30
events_experiences.source_boundary: public official organizer, booking, ticketing, registration, institution, government, university, platform, editorial, and public social sources

global_market.time_window: signals published or materially accelerated from 2026-06-01 through 2026-08-30
global_market.source_boundary: public official operators, local-language press, platform inventories, accelerator batches, product launches, jobs, metrics, portfolios, and credible market sources

workers.source_strategy: official openings, branch pages, selection bodies, booking and merchant commerce
map, editorial, news and discovery indexes for openings and offers
non-food, wellness, retail, IP collaboration and small-operator public channels
broad public web search without department memory, watchlists or regression examples
official ticketing, booking, venue and cultural institution inventories
registration, government, university, startup, meetup and program applications
fandom, participatory sport, social ritual, community and public social/editorial discovery
broad public web search without department memory, watchlists or regression examples
startup launches, accelerators, Product Hunt, Hacker News and official product metrics
consumer, lifestyle, wellness, social, dating, retail and hospitality formats in local-language sources
VC portfolios, investment theses, jobs, geographic expansion and economic durability evidence
broad multilingual public web search without department memory, watchlists or regression examples

prohibitions: No recommendation chip, score, rank or rejection during discovery
No product feed or app exposure
No automatic playbook or GBrain mutation
No login, CAPTCHA, private API or access-control bypass
No raw review text, reviewer identity or unlicensed media reuse
